title: Verify the Require Review setting drives the review flow when turned on
permissions_required: Admin / owner (settings) + Work Order edit access.
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin at https://sv7301.qa.shopview.com.
2. Require Review Before Completion is ON and saved.
steps: 1. Open a work order with approved lines.
2. Start completion.
3. Observe that the review flow is used.
expected: 1. With Require Review ON, completing routes into the review flow rather than completing directly.
notes: Verified 2026-07-06 — the settings toggle drives the flow (08-settings-workorders.png, S16-04-review-wizard.png).

title: Verify the completion CTA relabels to 'Complete & Send to Review' when review is on
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. Require Review is ON.
3. A work order with approved lines is ready to complete.
steps: 1. Click Complete Work Order.
2. Read the wizard's primary CTA label.
expected: 1. The primary CTA reads 'Complete & Send to Review' (Send to Review).
notes: Verified 2026-07-06 (S16-04-review-wizard.png).

title: Verify the Details step collects only mileage and engine hours when review is on (VIN captured later by reviewer)
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. Require Review is ON.
3. A work order missing mileage/hours/VIN is ready to complete.
steps: 1. Start completion and reach the Details step.
2. Note which vehicle fields are collected.
expected: 1. The Details step collects mileage and engine hours only.
2. VIN is NOT collected here; it is captured later by the reviewer in the Mark Reviewed dialog.
notes: Not isolated in VIU (the review Details split was not separately asserted). Needs live verification.

title: Verify 'Receive Parts' routes to the shared receive page (no inline modal) in the review flow
permissions_required: Work Order edit access + receive access.
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. Require Review is ON with a part-bearing work order.
steps: 1. Start completion and click Receive Parts.
2. Observe the destination.
expected: 1. Receive Parts opens the shared receive page (not an inline modal).
design_ref: WO Review Flow.html; Receive Vendor Parts - v2.html
notes: Not driven in VIU. Needs live verification.

title: Verify Send to Review moves the WO to Review (amber) with a 'Ready for Review' banner and locks lines to Complete
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. Require Review is ON and a work order with approved lines is in the completion wizard.
steps: 1. Click Complete & Send to Review.
2. Observe the work order status and banner.
3. Check the lines state and inventory pick state.
expected: 1. The work order status becomes Review (amber).
2. A 'Ready for Review' / 'Sent for review' indication is shown.
3. Lines lock to Complete and inventory is auto-picked.
notes: Status→Review + 'Sent for review' verified 2026-07-06 (S16-05-after-send.png). Line-lock and auto-pick details (R6) not separately asserted.

title: Verify the Mark Reviewed dialog captures VIN (required) and disables Confirm until VIN is entered
permissions_required: Reviewer role (manager/foreman) — matrix TBD. Verified here as admin.
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A work order is in Review state.
steps: 1. Click Mark Reviewed.
2. Observe the VIN field.
3. Clear the VIN and check the Confirm Review button, then enter a VIN.
expected: 1. The Mark Reviewed dialog exposes a VIN field (input_review_vin), required if missing.
2. Confirm Review is disabled until a VIN is present.
3. With a VIN, Confirm Review is enabled.
design_ref: WO Review Flow.html; WO Review Flow - Handoff.md (test IDs)
notes: Verified 2026-07-06 — dialog with VIN field, VIN pre-filled from asset, Confirm enabled (S16-06-mark-reviewed-dialog.png, S16-07-review-filled.png). Confirm-disabled-until-VIN inferred from VIN-required rule but not forced empty.

title: Verify on Send to Review lines lock to Complete and inventory is auto-picked
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A work order with an inventory line just went to Review.
steps: 1. Open the work order in Review state.
2. Check the line states.
3. Check whether inventory was auto-picked.
expected: 1. Lines are locked to Complete.
2. Inventory has been auto-picked.
notes: Not separately asserted in VIU. Needs live verification.

title: Verify Confirm Review moves the WO to a distinct Reviewed state requiring a separate final Complete Work Order
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A work order is in Review with the Mark Reviewed dialog filled (VIN present).
steps: 1. Click Confirm Review.
2. Observe the resulting work order state.
3. Look for a separate final 'Complete Work Order' action.
expected: 1. EXPECTED PER SPEC: the WO moves to Reviewed (green) with a 'sign-off complete' banner.
2. A separate final Complete Work Order action is required to move to Complete.
notes: VIU BUG #4: after Confirm Review the WO went straight to Complete — no distinct Reviewed holding state / separate final Complete click was observed (S16-08-reviewed.png). May be admin auto-progression. Do not record as passing against the expected. See Open Questions.

title: Verify Mark Reviewed is available only to manager/foreman and disabled for an advisor with 'Awaiting review'
permissions_required: Depends on permissions matrix (TBD). Reviewer (manager/foreman) and advisor credentials required.
preconditions: 1. Manager/foreman and advisor credentials exist.
2. A work order is in Review state.
steps: 1. Sign in as an advisor and open the work order in Review.
2. Confirm Mark Reviewed is disabled with 'Awaiting review'.
3. Sign in as a manager/foreman and confirm Mark Reviewed is available.
expected: 1. EXPECTED PER SPEC: advisors see Mark Reviewed disabled with 'Awaiting review'.
2. Managers/foremen can Mark Reviewed. (Final expected depends on the permissions matrix — TBD.)
notes: Role-gating not testable in VIU (admin-only session; tech key = 403). Expected depends on the (TBD) permissions matrix and the open 'role-gating review: custom roles vs open for v1' question. See Open Questions.

title: Verify the Mark Reviewed dialog includes an optional review note field (input_review_note)
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. The Mark Reviewed dialog is open.
steps: 1. Look for an optional note field in the dialog.
2. Enter a note and Confirm.
expected: 1. EXPECTED PER SPEC: an optional review note field (input_review_note) is present.
2. A note can be entered and saved with the sign-off.
notes: VIU BUG #3: the Mark Reviewed dialog exposed ONLY the VIN field — no optional-note input (S16-06-mark-reviewed-dialog.png). Do not record as passing against the expected. See Open Questions.

title: Verify after sign-off the final Complete Work Order (any role) completes the WO and invoicing is blocked until reviewed
permissions_required: Work Order edit access + Finance access.
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A work order is in Reviewed state (or a Review state before sign-off for the invoicing-block check).
steps: 1. Before sign-off, attempt to invoice the work order.
2. After sign-off, click the final Complete Work Order (as any role).
3. Confirm the WO becomes Complete (invoice-ready).
expected: 1. Invoicing is blocked until the WO is reviewed.
2. After sign-off, the final Complete Work Order (any role) makes the WO Complete and invoice-ready.
notes: Overlaps VIU bug #4 (no distinct Reviewed state observed). Invoicing-block-until-reviewed not driven. Needs live verification.

title: Verify a 'Ready for Review' list filter/column surfaces the reviewer queue
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. At least one work order is in Review state.
steps: 1. Open the Work Orders list.
2. Look for a 'Ready for Review' filter or column.
3. Confirm work orders in Review appear in it.
expected: 1. EXPECTED PER SPEC: a 'Ready for Review' filter/column lists work orders awaiting review.
notes: A per-WO 'Ready for Review' indicator was seen (S16-05), but the list-level queue filter/column is flagged pending in the design handoff and was not verified. Needs dev complete / live verification.

title: Verify all lines must be approved to Send to Review (existing approve-line error)
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. Require Review is ON and a work order has one unapproved line.
steps: 1. Click Complete & Send to Review.
2. Attempt to send with an unapproved line.
expected: 1. Send to Review is blocked with the existing approve-line error while any line is unapproved.
notes: Not isolated in VIU (line-approval gate was PARTIAL). Needs live verification.

title: Verify cores are resolved per rules before sign-off and invoicing is blocked until both Reviewed and all cores resolved
permissions_required: Work Order edit access + Finance access.
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. Require Review is ON and a work order has inventory and special-order cores.
steps: 1. Resolve inventory cores in the completion modal (after Pick) before Send to Review.
2. For required-invoice, resolve special-order cores after the Receive round-trip before Send to Review; for optional-invoice, resolve at the Create Invoice gate after sign-off.
3. Attempt to invoice before both Reviewed and cores are resolved.
expected: 1. Inventory cores are resolved before Send to Review.
2. Special-order cores follow the vendor-invoice rules.
3. Invoicing is blocked until the WO is Reviewed AND all cores are resolved.
notes: Not driven in VIU. Needs live verification.

title: Verify the Require Review default for new vs existing orgs matches the agreed cohort rule
preconditions: 1. A newly-created org and an existing org are available.
2. Signed in as Admin for each.
steps: 1. Check the Require Review default on a brand-new org.
2. Check that existing orgs keep today's behavior (backfilled).
expected: 1. PENDING DECISION: the Require Review default follows the agreed cohort rule (e.g. on for bigger/existing shops), with existing orgs preserved via backfill.
notes: Spec §8 marks the require-review default as UNRESOLVED. Confirm the intended default before pass/fail. See Open Questions.

title: Verify the work order primary button reads 'Create Work Order'
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. You are on the Create Work Order form (/workorders → Create).
steps: 1. Open the Create Work Order form.
2. Read the primary button label.
expected: 1. The primary button reads 'Create Work Order'.
notes: Create flow verified during Story 2 setup (S2-01-create-form.png).

title: Verify required fields at completion appear in a centralized center modal and the tech story is NOT in that modal
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A work order requiring mileage/VIN is being completed.
steps: 1. Start completion.
2. Observe where required fields are collected.
3. Confirm the tech story is handled by its own flow, not inside this modal.
expected: 1. Required fields (mileage / VIN when required) are collected in a centralized center modal.
2. The tech story is NOT part of this modal (Story 17 handles it separately).
notes: Centralized Details modal verified (S2-13-details.png); tech story ran as its own gate before the wizard (S2-11-techstory.png).

title: Verify the success screen shows WO number and total with Done and Go to Invoice, and the invoice number is on the Finance step
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A work order has just been completed.
steps: 1. Read the success screen.
2. Confirm WO number, total, Done and Go to Invoice.
3. Confirm the invoice number is shown on the Finance step, not the success screen.
expected: 1. The success screen shows the WO number and total with Done and Go to Invoice.
2. The invoice number appears on the Finance step, not on the success screen.
notes: Success screen verified (S2-14-success.png). Finance-step invoice-number location not separately driven.

title: Verify the close-confirmation modal behavior (Close = closes modal only; Cancel = closes modal + returns to previous screen)
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A completion modal is open.
steps: 1. Trigger the close-confirmation modal.
2. Click Close (prominent/red) and observe.
3. Trigger it again and click Cancel (text link, far left) and observe.
expected: 1. PENDING DESIGN: Close closes the modal only (no discard) and stays on the work order.
2. Cancel closes the modal and returns to the previous screen.
notes: S15-R4 close-confirm design is explicitly pending ('Figma still to be added') — no design surface to test yet. Confirm before authoring expected. See Open Questions.

title: Verify only owner/admin can view and modify Work Order settings (non-admin blocked)
permissions_required: Depends on permissions matrix (TBD). Non-admin credential required.
preconditions: 1. A non-admin user account exists.
2. You can sign in as that user.
steps: 1. Sign in as the non-admin user.
2. Attempt to open and modify /administration/settings → Work Orders.
expected: 1. The non-admin cannot view or modify Work Order settings (final expected depends on the permissions matrix — TBD).
notes: BLOCKED in VIU (quick-login tech = 403; no non-admin session). Needs a real non-admin credential. Hypothesis to verify: backend may only enforce resource-level View/Edit while these are FE display gates (Custom Roles finding). See Open Questions.

title: Verify which roles can complete a work order (Simple completion)
permissions_required: Depends on permissions matrix (TBD). Multiple role credentials required.

2. A work order ready to complete exists.
steps: 1. For each role, attempt to complete a work order.
2. Record which roles can and cannot.
expected: 1. PENDING MATRIX: expected depends on the permissions matrix (TBD). Do not assume specific role outcomes.
notes: No permissions/role matrix supplied. Author only; expected depends on the matrix (TBD). See Open Questions.

title: Verify which roles can perform Bulk Receive
preconditions: 1. Credentials for several roles exist.
2. The Bulk Receive flow is available (Story 7/8 built).
steps: 1. For each role, attempt to reach and use Bulk Receive.
2. Record the outcomes.
expected: 1. PENDING MATRIX: expected depends on the permissions matrix (TBD).
notes: No matrix supplied; also Bulk Receive is not yet built. See Open Questions.

title: Verify which roles can Mark Reviewed (sign off)
permissions_required: Depends on permissions matrix (TBD). Manager/foreman + other role credentials required.
preconditions: 1. Credentials for manager/foreman and other roles exist.
2. A work order in Review state exists.
steps: 1. For each role, attempt to Mark Reviewed.
2. Record which roles can and cannot.
expected: 1. PENDING MATRIX: spec says manager/foreman only, but role-gating (custom roles vs open for v1) is UNRESOLVED. Expected depends on the matrix (TBD).
notes: Role-gating for review is an explicit open question. See Open Questions.

title: Verify the PO Receive button is hidden for office/readonly users
permissions_required: Depends on permissions matrix (TBD). Office/readonly credential required.
preconditions: 1. An office/readonly credential exists.
2. A WO-originated PO exists.
steps: 1. Sign in as an office/readonly user.
2. Open the PO list and detail.
3. Confirm the Receive action is not shown.
expected: 1. EXPECTED PER SPEC: office/readonly users do not see the Receive action (final expected depends on the permissions matrix — TBD).
notes: Not verifiable in VIU (no non-admin session). Needs an office/readonly credential. See Open Questions.

title: Verify whether the backend enforces the Simple-Flow settings or they are front-end display gates only
permissions_required: Admin (API access) + a lower role credential.
preconditions: 1. Signed in with API access.
2. A relevant Simple-Flow setting (e.g. Require Vendor Invoice Number) is ON.
steps: 1. Attempt the gated action directly via the API (bypassing the UI), e.g. completing without the required invoice.
2. Observe whether the backend rejects (403/422) or allows it (200/201).
expected: 1. PENDING DECISION: determine whether the backend enforces the setting (rejects) or the gate is front-end only (allows).
notes: §8 asks whether BE should enforce Simple-Flow settings. Hypothesis from Custom Roles: BE often enforces only resource-level View/Edit while granular gates are FE-only. Verify; do not assume. See Open Questions.

title: Verify whether review role-gating uses custom roles or is open for v1
preconditions: 1. Credentials for several roles exist.
2. A work order in Review state exists.
steps: 1. Determine which roles can sign off review.
2. Determine whether this is governed by a custom-role permission or open to all.
expected: 1. PENDING DECISION: whether review sign-off is gated by custom roles or open for v1 is unresolved.
notes: Explicit open question. See Open Questions.

title: Verify completion is blocked when required mileage is missing
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. Require Mileage is ON and the work order has no mileage.
steps: 1. Start completion.
2. Leave mileage empty and try to proceed.
expected: 1. Completion is blocked until mileage is entered.
notes: Details step seen (S2-13) but empty-field block not isolated. Needs live verification.

title: Verify completion is blocked when a required VIN is missing (non-review flow)
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. VIN is required for this org's completion and the work order has no VIN.
3. Require Review is OFF (VIN is collected at completion in the non-review flow).
steps: 1. Start completion.
2. Leave VIN empty and try to proceed.
expected: 1. Completion is blocked until the VIN is entered.
notes: Not isolated in VIU. Needs live verification. (In review flow, VIN is captured at Mark Reviewed — see SF-REV-06.)

title: Verify completion is blocked when required engine hours are missing
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. Require Engine Hours is ON and the work order has no engine hours.
steps: 1. Start completion.
2. Leave engine hours empty and try to proceed.
expected: 1. Completion is blocked until engine hours are entered.
notes: Not driven in VIU. Needs live verification.

title: Verify the tech-story Next/Continue button stays disabled while the story textarea is empty
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. The tech-story modal is open on a line.
steps: 1. Leave the story textarea empty.
2. Check the Next/Continue button.
3. Type any text and check again.
expected: 1. With the textarea empty, Next/Continue is disabled.
2. After typing text, Next/Continue becomes enabled.
notes: Verified 2026-07-06 — Continue disabled until non-empty (S2-11-techstory.png).

title: Verify a required-invoice receive is blocked without a vendor invoice number
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. Require Vendor Invoice Number is ON and a part is being received.
steps: 1. On the receive surface, leave the vendor invoice number empty.
2. Attempt to receive.
expected: 1. Receiving is blocked without a vendor invoice number.
2. Once an invoice number is entered, receiving is allowed.
notes: Not driven in VIU. Needs live verification.

title: Verify a vendor-missing part cannot be received without both a vendor and a part number
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A vendor-missing part is on a receive surface.
steps: 1. Attempt to receive with no vendor.
2. Attempt to receive with a vendor but no part number.
3. Provide both and receive.
expected: 1. Receiving is blocked without a vendor.
2. Receiving is blocked without a part number.
3. Receiving succeeds only with both.
notes: Not driven in VIU. Needs live verification.

title: Verify Confirm Review is disabled until a VIN is entered in the Mark Reviewed dialog
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. The Mark Reviewed dialog is open on a WO with no VIN on the asset.
steps: 1. Clear the VIN field.
2. Check the Confirm Review button.
3. Enter a VIN and check again.
expected: 1. Confirm Review is disabled while VIN is empty.
2. Confirm Review enables after a VIN is entered.
notes: In VIU the VIN was pre-filled from the asset, so the empty-VIN disabled state was not forced. Needs a WO with no VIN to verify.

title: Verify re-completing after cancelling does not create duplicate POs
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A part-bearing work order had completion started and cancelled once.
steps: 1. Cancel the first completion attempt.
2. Start and complete again.
3. Inspect the POs.
expected: 1. No duplicate POs are created on the second attempt.
notes: Not driven in VIU. Needs live verification. (Also covered from the flow side in SF-COMP-23.)

title: Verify the sell field is locked after the work order is invoiced/paid with a lock icon and tooltip
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A part on an invoiced/paid work order is on a receive surface.
steps: 1. Open the receive surface for the invoiced/paid WO part.
2. Try to edit the sell field.
3. Hover the lock icon.
expected: 1. The sell field is locked (not editable).
2. A lock icon and tooltip 'Locked — this part is already invoiced or paid' are shown.
3. Only cost remains editable.
notes: Not driven in VIU. Needs live verification.

title: Verify the same vendor invoice number can be reused across POs (uniqueness relaxed)
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. Two POs for the same vendor are being received.
steps: 1. Enter the same invoice number on both POs.
2. Receive both.
expected: 1. The reused invoice number is accepted (uniqueness is relaxed).
2. Both POs receive successfully.
notes: Not driven in VIU. Needs live verification.

title: Verify the approve-line error text appears when completing with an unapproved line
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A work order has one unapproved line and all other gates satisfied.
steps: 1. Click Complete Work Order.
2. Read the error shown at the final confirm.
expected: 1. The existing 'you need to approve the line to complete the work order' error is shown.
2. Completion does not proceed until the line is approved.
notes: PARTIAL in VIU — error not cleanly isolated (S17-02-approval-error.png). Needs a WO whose only blocker is the unapproved line.

title: Verify in-stock parts decrement inventory and write Part History on simple completion (skip path still runs lifecycle)
permissions_required: Work Order edit access + Inventory visibility.
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A work order has an in-stock inventory part; its on-hand quantity is noted.
steps: 1. Complete the work order via the simple (skip) path.
2. Check the part's on-hand quantity and Part History.
expected: 1. The in-stock part's on-hand quantity decrements.
2. A Part History entry is written.
3. The skip path's status setter does not bypass inventory movement / Part History / catalog / delivery.
notes: §8 open question: auto-receive of in-stock inventory on simple completion is unconfirmed, and the spec flags the bare status setter as an integrity risk. Not driven in VIU. See Open Questions.

title: Verify Create POs OFF produces no PO, vendor bill or AP sync and no catalog/inventory sync
permissions_required: Admin / owner (settings) + Work Order edit access + QuickBooks visibility.
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. Create Purchase Orders is OFF (see SF-SET-03).
3. A work order with a vendor/found part exists.
steps: 1. Complete the work order with Create POs OFF.
2. Check for any PO, vendor bill, AP sync.
3. Check for any catalog/inventory sync of the vendor/found part.
expected: 1. EXPECTED PER SPEC: no PO, no vendor bill, no AP sync.
2. No catalog/inventory sync (part is received at request time only).
notes: Blocked by VIU bug #1: no 'Create Purchase Orders' toggle exists, so Create POs OFF cannot be configured. See Open Questions.

title: Verify POs ON plus receiving runs the full pipeline: receive → Delivery → Vendor Bill → QuickBooks (both surfaces sync)
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. Create POs is on and a work order has a receivable vendor part.

2. Check that a Delivery, then a Vendor Bill, then a QuickBooks sync occur.
3. Repeat via the Bulk Receive surface (once built) and confirm it also syncs.
expected: 1. Receiving creates a Delivery, then a Vendor Bill, then syncs to QuickBooks.
2. Both receive surfaces sync the vendor bill (only complete-simple bypasses this).
notes: Not driven in VIU; needs QuickBooks inspection. Bulk Receive surface not yet built. Needs live verification.

title: Verify a vendorless / no-PN part has zero inventory interaction until a vendor and/or part number is added

2. Add a vendor and PN, then re-check.
expected: 1. Before a vendor/PN, there is zero inventory interaction (no item, no history).
2. After a vendor and PN are added, normal inventory handling applies.
notes: Not driven in VIU. Needs live verification.

title: Verify Vendor Missing POs are excluded from QuickBooks until a vendor and part number are provided

2. A Vendor Missing PO exists.
steps: 1. Check QuickBooks sync for the Vendor Missing PO.

expected: 1. While vendor/PN are missing, the PO is excluded from QuickBooks.

title: Verify the Journal Entry / Inventory sync to QuickBooks fires on invoice creation (not PO-dependent)
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.

preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.

expected: 1. Part History is preserved / created for the now inventory-tracked part.
